claim_text: 來源機構：Asia Pacific Education Review（Springer）；資料標題：Learner–AI cognitive collaboration for creativity: a divergence–convergence model in elementary project-based learning；來源刊登日：2026-11-21。作者摘要報告：研究為設計與發展研究，為小學專題式學習發展學習者與 AI 協作（LAC）的原則與教學模式，並檢視這些原則在課堂中如何運作；原則組成四階段的發散—聚斂教學模式，界定學習者、AI 與教師的角色；課堂研究有 36 名六年級學生，LAC 教學組與對照組各 18 人。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

claim_text: 來源機構：International Journal of Technology in Education（ISTES）；資料標題：Artificial Intelligence through the Eyes of Primary Education Students: Analysis of Gender, Educational Cycle, Rural–Urban Differences, and Frequency of Use；來源刊登日：2026-11-20。作者摘要報告：研究因小學生如何看待 AI 的實證資料稀少，檢視其看法是否因性別、教育階段、就讀參與研究的鄉村或城市學校及使用習慣而不同；參與者為第二、三階段（三至六年級）391 名學生，以改編自 Chai 等人（2021）的 22 題量表蒐集資料，涵蓋自我效能、準備度、社會效益、素養與未來意圖；作者報告學生整體態度正面，未見明顯性別差異。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Artificial Intelligence through the Eyes of Primary Education Students: Analysis of Gender, Educational Cycle, Rural–Urban Differences, and Frequency of Use
title_zh: 小學生眼中的人工智慧：性別、教育階段、城鄉差異與使用頻率分析
source_organization: International Journal of Technology in Education（ISTES）
source_locator: 期刊文章頁（ijte.net，2026-11-22 讀取 200）：Published 2026-11-20（In Press）；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 1、2、3、5 句
original_excerpt: Owing to the scarcity of empirical data regarding how Primary Education students perceive Artificial Intelligence (AI), this research examined variations based on gender, educational cycle, attendance at the participating rural or urban schools, and usage habits. … The participant group included 391 students from the second and third cycles (Grades 3 to 6). … Data collection involved a 22-item instrument adapted from Chai et al. (2021), focusing on five distinct areas: self-efficacy, readiness, social benefit, literacy, and future intent. … The findings revealed overall positive attitudes, without notable gender-based disparities.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究問題、樣本、量表與作者所述的整體態度及性別差異；教育階段、使用頻率與城鄉學校的關聯細節不寫入，不寫因果。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（International Journal of Technology in Education，不在監測清單；管理者 2026-11-22 確認單篇例外收錄）；391 名三至六年級學生的自陳問卷；摘要未寫國別，作者任職西班牙大學（知識庫國別依此標註）；城鄉比較限參與研究的學校，非全國代表。

ai_lit_note: 小學生對 AI 的自我效能、準備度、社會效益、素養與未來意圖等知覺，屬學生 AI 素養（A），對應 S-BAS「覺察AI的世界並產生好奇心」
summary_evidence_spans: Owing to the scarcity of empirical data regarding how Primary Education students perceive Artificial Intelligence (AI), this research examined variations based on gender, educational cycle, attendance at the participating rural or urban schools, and usage habits.
The participant group included 391 students from the second and third cycles (Grades 3 to 6).
Data collection involved a 22-item instrument adapted from Chai et al. (2021), focusing on five distinct areas: self-efficacy, readiness, social benefit, literacy, and future intent.
The findings revealed overall positive attitudes, without notable gender-based disparities.
